title: Prisma Advanced Features
description: Master transactions, middleware, extensions, connection pooling, error handling, and query performance in Prisma.
longDescription: This module covers advanced Prisma features that production applications rely on. You will learn about transactions, middleware, extensions, connection pooling with pgBouncer, connection management in serverless environments, error handling patterns, and query logging and performance optimization.
whatYouLearn: Use middleware and extensions in Prisma Client
Manage connections in serverless and Next.js environments
Handle errors gracefully with Prisma Client
